s: SikaRoof® VersiScape Spacer Tab is an attachment used on top of adjustable pedestals to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of safety panels in raised landscape finishes. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it supports four safety panel corners that rest on top of the adjustable pedestal.

SikaRoof® VersiScape Spacer Tab is used in conjuntion with SikaRoof® VersiScape™ Panels and may be manufactured in two different thicknesses and heights to support different types of landscape finishes.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Spacer tabs are used with safety panel for raised flooring for podiums, balconies and roof terraces. The safety panel may be used to raise conventional 600 x 600 mm pavers, pavers of varying sizes, artificial grass, or a combination of the three.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.
